title: 第十九章 龙虾老巢第二十章 发笔横财
content_zh:
殷东怦然心动，只是迅速压下来，随后说：“你帮我带小宝，我就出海去看看。
今天天气不错，兴许还能有点不错的收获。”
王海娇问：“你家的渔船……”
话到一半，她又赶紧打住。
殷东知道她未说完的话，他父母就是出海打渔遇上风暴，船毁人亡，他家己经没船了。
看她像说错话的孩子，一脸的紧张，他不由失笑道：“我家的拖网渔船没了，还有小舰板啊，你还怕我没船出海？”
王海娇讪讪的一笑。
殷东家里现在就剩了一条小舰板，那还是殷东爷爷生前用过的，搁在后院，他爸还用油布盖着，隔段时间还会刷漆护理，所在这条可以当古董的舰板船，理论上还是可以下海正常行驶的。
他把渔网等能用得上的东西，都收到舰板船上，再把船抓起来，直接从后院的侧门出去，懒得去村东头沙滩上那条简易的老码头，往前面的海湾去了。
大金也跟上来了，又被他赶回家去。
舰板下水，殷东确定并没有渗水，就划着船出海了。
出门有些迟了，但海面上起雾了看不远，他没打算走远，就在近海搜寻，随便弄点什么渔获。
白山镇交通不便，近海污染相对较轻，但是整体的大环境不好，近海的生态环境被破坏，这里也不可能幸免，近海的收获注定不会大。
殷东也没抱太大的期望，先找到一个露出海面的礁石把舰板船固定了。
殷东以前下水要穿潜水衣，有了早上的经历，他出海连潜水衣都懒得带，直接光膀子下水，也没游远，觉得在礁石周围多找一找，兴许能有什么惊喜也不一定。
当然，他也没抱太大期望，反正礁石缝里找点贝类虾类也是收获嘛，卖不出钱，自己吃也行啊。
一直下潜了近五十米，都没感觉到一点不适感。
是因为那个诡异的小贝壳吗？
他心情激荡，一时热血上头，想测试下自己的下潜极限，就顺着礁石往水深处潜，忽然发现有一条鱼突然在不远处出现，又迅速消失在。
他赶紧过一看，那条消失的鱼是顺着礁石的缝隙钻进去了，透过礁石裂隙，能看到礁石裂隙倾斜向下，在深处形成一个中空的石洞，洞底是一片海草滩，生活着一个龙虾群，大龙虾不少，都有五彩花纹。

“我卧了个大槽！
这都是花龙啊！”
殷东狂喜大叫，又被海水呛得一阵猛咳，然后他抱着礁石一阵猛亲，刚好礁隙里爬出一只小螃蟹，受惊之下，蟹钳夹在他嘴巴上，顿时流出血。
他的好心情一点没受影响，把螃蟹弄下来，也没弄死这丫头，还挺大气的放了它，
随后，他又意识到在这么深的水域，他的水下视力己经叼爆了！
双重惊喜过后，殷东感觉有些晕了，而且他带的小网兜可装不下整个龙虾群，得去把渔网拿下来。
他上浮到海面，伸手抹了把脸上的水，又忍不住大笑出声，重生以来的憋闷也散了不少，“我靠靠靠，太忒么逆天，劳资这日子是否极泰来了啊！”
content_en:
Yin Dong's heart was pounding, but he quickly suppressed it, and then said: "You help me take Xiaobao, and I will go to the sea to have a look.
The weather is nice today, maybe we can get some good results. "
Wang Haijiao asked: "Your fishing boat..."
Halfway through her words, she quickly stopped.
Yin Dong knew what she had not finished saying. His parents were out fishing at sea and encountered a storm. The boat was destroyed and everyone died. His family had no boat.
Seeing that she looked like a child who had said something wrong, with a nervous look on her face, he couldn't help but laugh and said: "My trawler is gone, and there is still a small deck. Are you still afraid that I will go to sea without a boat?"
Wang Hai smiled coquettishly.
There is only one small shipboard left in Yin Dong's house. It was used by Yin Dong's grandfather before his death. It is stored in the backyard. His father still covers it with oilcloth and paints and cares it every once in a while. This shipboard boat, which can be regarded as an antique, can theoretically go into the sea and travel normally.
He put all the fishing nets and other useful things on the boat, then grabbed the boat and went out directly from the side door of the backyard. He was too lazy to go to the simple old pier on the beach at the east end of the village and headed to the bay in front.
Dajin also followed and was driven home by him again.
After the ship was launched into the water, Yin Dong made sure there was no water seepage and rowed the boat out to sea.
It was a little late to go out, but the sea was foggy and he couldn't see far. He didn't plan to go far, so he searched offshore and caught some random fish.
Baishan Town has inconvenient transportation and relatively light offshore pollution. However, the overall environment is not good and the ecological environment of the offshore has been destroyed. It is not immune here. The harvest from the offshore is destined to be small.
Yin Dong didn't have high expectations, so he first found a rock out of the sea and fixed the ship.
Yin Dong used to wear a wetsuit when going into the water. After this morning's experience, he didn't even bother to bring a wetsuit when he went out to sea. He just went into the water shirtless and didn't swim far. He thought that if he searched around the rocks, he might find some surprises.
Of course, he didn't have high expectations. Anyway, finding some shellfish and shrimps in the crevices of the reef was still a harvest. If you couldn't sell them for money, you could just eat them yourself.
I dived nearly fifty meters without feeling any discomfort.
Is it because of that weird little shell?
His mood was agitated, and he wanted to test his diving limit, so he dived deep into the water along the reef. Suddenly, he found a fish suddenly appeared not far away, and then quickly disappeared.
He quickly took a look and saw that the missing fish had gone in along the cracks in the reef. Through the cracks in the reef, he could see that the cracks in the reef were sloping downward, forming a hollow stone cave in the depths. At the bottom of the cave was a seaweed beach, where a group of lobsters lived. There were many large lobsters with colorful patterns.
“I’m in a big trough!
These are all flower dragons! "
Yin Dong screamed with joy and coughed violently due to the sea water. Then he hugged the reef and kissed her fiercely. A small crab crawled out of the gap in the reef. Frightened, the crab's claws clamped on his mouth, causing blood to flow immediately.
His good mood was not affected at all. He got the crab off and didn't kill the girl. He let it go in a big way.
Then, he realized that in such deep water, his underwater vision was already damaged!
After the double surprise, Yin Dong felt a little dizzy, and the small net bag he brought could not hold the entire lobster group, so he had to take down the fishing net.
He floated to the surface of the sea, stretched out his hand to wipe the water on his face, and couldn't help laughing out loud. The depression since his rebirth also dissipated a lot, "Holy shit, it's so incredible. Is this a great day for labor and management?"
